title: LinkedIn Connection Mutual Connections Leaderboard
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=linkedin:connection mutual_connections=*
| stats sum(mutual_connections) as total_value, avg(mutual_connections) as avg_value by industry
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks industry values by total and average mutual connections across LinkedIn connection events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `mutual_connections` values for each LinkedIn connection event and review total and average mutual connections by industry.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total mutual connections.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which industry shows the biggest mutual connections numbers in your LinkedIn connection data.
